scenes.caption: theoros reads New Eden from EVE's own public data
scenes.say: theoros is a board of New Eden, and it reads the game's own public data.

scenes.caption: One space, two pictures: the shell and the pane
scenes.say: One space, drawn twice: the sphere a system sits in, and the region beside it.

scenes.caption: Zoom: the frame holds still while the units spread inside it
scenes.say: Zooming keeps the frame fixed, and the units spread inside it.

scenes.caption: Turn: the sphere moves under a frame that does not
scenes.say: Turning moves the sphere under the frame, so the picture stays put.

scenes.caption: Stacked: one column, the pictures one above the other
scenes.say: The two pictures can stack in one column.

scenes.caption: Side by side: the region beside the sphere
scenes.say: Or stand side by side, the region beside the sphere.

scenes.caption: The pane takes the frame
scenes.say: The pane can take the whole frame.

scenes.caption: One press in, the same press out
scenes.say: And one press gives it back.

scenes.caption: A system is a fabric of facts: twelve readings, three chains
scenes.say: Every system is a fabric of facts: twelve readings and three chains of work.

scenes.caption: A berth takes the capacity question the volume reading raised
scenes.say: A berth takes the capacity question that the volume reading raised.

scenes.caption: A yard answers the yield question the belt count raised
scenes.say: A yard answers the yield question that the belt count raised.

scenes.caption: A record is an address: pressing one seeks the run
scenes.say: A record is an address. Press one, and the run moves to that second.

scenes.caption: The run replays on its own
scenes.say: The run then replays on its own.

scenes.caption: One run, one row a writer: each fact keeps the origin that wrote it
scenes.say: Read by writer, every fact keeps the origin that wrote it.

scenes.caption: Find reaches every system, not just this one
scenes.say: And find reaches every system, not only the one you stand in.
